## Create Testing File

```{r}
library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)
```

```{r}
if  (!file.exists("small-restaurant-visits-209874.csv")) {
  fn <- "restaurant-visits-209874.csv"

  # read the first 10 rows of the csv into a data frame
  some_lines <- read.csv(fn, nrows = 10)

  # create a smaller version of the csv for testing
  write.csv(some_lines, "small-restaurant-visits-209874.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
str(df)
```

```{r}
conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "restaurants-db-02102026.sqlitedb")
dbListTables(conn)
```

```{r}
dbListFields(conn, "restaurants")
dbReadTable(conn, "restaurants")
```

```{sql connection = conn}
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'restaurants';
```

```{sql connection = dbcon}
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS raw_csv_data;
```

```{sql connection = dbcon}
CREATE TABLE raw_csv_data (
    RestaurantID            INT,
    ServerEmpID             INT,
    ServerName              TEXT,
    VisitDate               DATE,
    VisitTime               TIME,
    MealType                TEXT,
    PartySize               INT,
    WaitTime                INT,
    CustomerName            TEXT,
    CustomerPhone           TEXT,
    CustomerEmail           TEXT,
    LoyaltyMember           BOOLEAN,
    FoodBill                NUMERIC(10,2),
    TipAmount               NUMERIC(10,2),
    FoodDiscountPercentage  NUMERIC(4,2),
    PaymentMethod           TEXT,
    orderedAlcohol          BOOLEAN,
    AlcoholBill             NUMERIC(10,2),

    CONSTRAINT chk_restaurant_id  CHECK (RestaurantID > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_server_emp_id  CHECK (ServerEmpID > 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_visit_date     CHECK (VisitDate BETWEEN '2018-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'),
    CONSTRAINT chk_meal_type      CHECK (MealType IN ('Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Take-Out')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_party_size     CHECK (PartySize BETWEEN 1 AND 25),
    CONSTRAINT chk_wait_time      CHECK (WaitTime BETWEEN 0 AND 240),
    CONSTRAINT chk_customer_email CHECK (CustomerEmail = '' OR CustomerEmail LIKE '%_@_%._%'),
    CONSTRAINT chk_loyalty        CHECK (LoyaltyMember IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_food_bill      CHECK (FoodBill >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_tip_amount     CHECK (TipAmount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_discount       CHECK (FoodDiscountPercentage BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
    CONSTRAINT chk_payment_method CHECK (PaymentMethod IN ('Cash', 'Credit Card', 'Mobile Payment')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_ordered_alc    CHECK (orderedAlcohol IN (0, 1)),
    CONSTRAINT chk_alcohol_bill   CHECK (AlcoholBill >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_alcohol_consistent CHECK (orderedAlcohol = 1 OR AlcoholBill = 0)
)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("restaurant-visits-209874.csv", colClasses = "character", na.strings = "NA", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                    check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
wt <- which(df$WaitTime < 0 | df$WaitTime > 240)
df$WaitTime[wt]
```
```{r}
rid <- which(df$RestaurantID < 0 | typeof(df$RestaurantID) != "integer")
df$RestaurantID[rid]
```


```{r}
sid <- which(df$ServerEmpID < 0 | typeof(df$ServerEmpID) != "integer")
df$ServerEmpID[sid]
```

```{r}
vd <- which(df$VisitDate == '0000-00-00')
df$visitDate[vd]
```

```{r}
mt <- which(!df$MealType %in% c('Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Dinner', 'Take-Out'))
df$MealType[mt]
```

```{r}
ps <- which(df$PartySize < 1 | df$PartySize > 25)
df$PartySize[ps]
```

```{r}
email <- which(!grepl("^\\S+@\\S+\\.\\S+$", df$CustomerEmail) & df$CustomerEmail != "")
df$CustomerEmail[email]
```
```{r}
loyalty <- which(!df$LoyaltyMember %in% c(0, 1))
df$LoyaltyMember[loyalty]
```

```{r}
bad.foodbill    <- which(df.full$FoodBill < 0)

bad.tip         <- which(df.full$TipAmount < 0)

bad.discount    <- which(df.full$FoodDiscountPercentage < 0 | df.full$FoodDiscountPercentage > 1)

bad.payment     <- which(!df.full$PaymentMethod %in% c("Cash", "Credit Card", "Mobile Payment"))

bad.orderedalc  <- which(!df.full$orderedAlcohol %in% c("yes", "no"))

bad.alcoholbill <- which(df.full$AlcoholBill < 0)

bad.alcconsist  <- which(df.full$orderedAlcohol == "no" & df.full$AlcoholBill != 0)
 
```

```{r}
sapply(list(foodbill    = bad.foodbill,
            tip         = bad.tip,
            discount    = bad.discount,
            payment     = bad.payment,
            orderedalc  = bad.orderedalc,
            alcoholbill = bad.alcoholbill,
            alcconsist  = bad.alcconsist),
       length)


```
